$PROBLEM Schoemaker oral1_1cpt_kaVCl | sch:oral1_1cpt_kaVCl bs_119 | FOCEI $ABBR DERIV2=NO $INPUT ID TIME AMT DV MDV EVID CMT $DATA data.csv IGNORE=@ $SUBROUTINES ADVAN2 TRANS2
$PK ; individual parameters: theta_i = exp(MU + ETA), MU = log(typical value) [+ covariate effects]; ; parameters without IIV have an ETA with OMEGA 0 FIX (MU referencing for FOCE FAST) MU_1 = LOG(THETA(1)) CL = EXP(MU_1 + ETA(1)) MU_2 = LOG(THETA(2)) V = EXP(MU_2 + ETA(2)) MU_3 = LOG(THETA(3)) KA = EXP(MU_3 + ETA(3)) S2 = V
$ERROR IPRED = F Y = IPRED + IPRED*EPS(1)
$THETA (0, 2.71828) ; 1 Cl_pop (0, 54.5982) ; 2 V_pop (0, 1.10517) ; 3 ka_pop
$OMEGA 0.2000003618 ; ETA(1) Cl (omega = 0.447214) 0.2000003618 ; ETA(2) V (omega = 0.447214) 0.2000003618 ; ETA(3) ka (omega = 0.447214)
$SIGMA 0.04 ; EPS(1) DV proportional (b = 0.2)
; -2LL: importance sampling (EONLY=1), proposal t with 5 df; first IMP adapts the proposal, ; the second evaluates with 10000 samples per individual (as Monolix). Reported value: ; 'OBJECTIVE FUNCTION VALUE WITH CONSTANT' of the last step. $EST METHOD=COND INTERACTION FAST MAXEVAL=9999 NSIG=3 SIGL=9 PRINT=5 NOABORT FORMAT=s1PE17.10 PARAFILE=OFF $EST METHOD=IMP INTERACTION EONLY=1 NITER=5 ISAMPLE=1000 DF=5 ISCALE_MIN=1 ISCALE_MAX=1 MAPITER=0 CTYPE=0 SIGL=9 PRINT=1 SEED=23456 NOCOV=1 FORMAT=s1PE17.10 PARAFILE=ON $EST METHOD=IMP INTERACTION EONLY=1 NITER=1 ISAMPLE=10000 DF=5 ISCALE_MIN=1 ISCALE_MAX=1 MAPITER=0 CTYPE=0 SIGL=9 PRINT=1 SEED=34567 NOCOV=1 FNLETA=0 PARAFILE=ON
